stem: Which idea about the ancient Egyptians is supported by information in paragraphs 4 and 14?

options.label: A
options.text: They studied a variety of writings while in school.

options.label: B
options.text: They were primarily concerned with maintaining their health and safety.

options.label: C
options.text: They used writing for many different purposes.

options.label: D
options.text: They enjoyed writing for entertainment more than practical reasons.
